bear_assumptions: About USD 70 million of forward continuing-operations revenue at 1x enterprise value/revenue, USD 180 million of residual net financial resources and 75 million diluted shares as customer programs contract, autonomous-lab adoption remains slow, cash burn stays near guidance, and equity issuance continues.
base_assumptions: About USD 100 million of forward continuing-operations revenue at 3x enterprise value/revenue, USD 230 million of residual net financial resources and 70 million diluted shares as autonomous-lab and tool offerings stabilize growth and restructuring lowers losses, while cash burn and stock compensation remain material.
bull_assumptions: About USD 140 million of forward continuing-operations revenue at 6x enterprise value/revenue, USD 280 million of residual net financial resources and 68 million diluted shares as autonomous-lab utilization, Datapoints and Solutions adoption accelerate, losses fall sharply, and dilution slows.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if recurring autonomous-lab, Datapoints or Solutions revenue and lower cash burn support scenarios that clear expected-return, base-upside, bear/base and expected/bear payoff, margin-of-safety, confidence and accepted-relationship gates; downgrade if continuing revenue contracts further, adoption fails to convert into repeatable revenue, burn exceeds guidance, restricted cash or financing needs increase, or dilution materially offsets progress.
